name: Bitch Gakuen ga Seijun na Hazu ga Nai!!?
original_name: ビッチ学園が清純なはずがないっ！！？
source:
The Amami family, Hassaku, his older sister Mao and younger sister Airi. Their parents founded a school to foster love between the students but they passed away in an accident. Now their aunt Mei has taken possession of the school and forced Mao away so nobody could challenger her position. Mei's plan is to turn the school into a [url=https://vndb.org/v5932]Mecha-con[/url] school where girls are trained to be sold as the perfect brides for wealthy men. To do that she needs to convert the school into an all girl's school.

Unfortunately for Mei the school charter demands the school be co-ed so she has the girls under her control force the boys out through bullying. Now the only male student left is Hassaku. Mei's daughter and their cousin Arisu pulls Hassaku's pants and underwear down in front of all the girls in his class to humiliate him but his penis is huge! Also at that moment he's rescued by his sister Mao who's returned home after many months. Mao declares to her aunt Mei and cousin Arisu that she will protect her brother and return the school to the school for fostering love their parents believed in.

Now it's a battle between their aunt Mei who wishes to control the school and rid it of the last male student and the Amami siblings who wish to restore it to their parents dream. Mei tries to use sex to blackmail and humiliate Hassaku but if Hassaku can convince the girls to love him he can create a Mecha-con of his own and bring romance back to the school.
translation:
天海家族由八作、姐姐麻央和妹妹爱莉组成。父母创办学校，致力于培养学生之间的爱情，却在事故中去世。如今，姨母芽衣接管学校，并把麻央赶走，避免有人挑战自己的地位。

芽衣计划把学校变成[url=https://vndb.org/v5932]相亲[/url]学校，训练女孩，让她们成为富人眼中的完美新娘。为此，她必须把学校改造成女子学校。

可惜，校规要求男女共学，于是芽衣让受她控制的女孩通过霸凌赶走男生。现在唯一留下的男学生是八作。芽衣的女儿、也是八作的表妹有栖，当着全班女生的面扒下八作的裤子和内裤羞辱他，却发现他的阴茎巨大！就在这时，他被几个月前离家的姐姐麻央救下。麻央向姨母芽衣与表妹有栖宣布，她会保护弟弟，让学校回到父母坚信的、培养爱情的学校。

于是，姨母芽衣想控制学校、清除最后一名男学生，与希望恢复父母梦想的天海兄妹之间展开了战斗。芽衣试图用性爱勒索、羞辱八作，但如果八作能让女孩们爱上自己，就能建立属于自己的相亲学校，把浪漫带回校园。
